name: ImmunityBio, Inc.
moat_justification: First-in-class approved IL-15 agonist (ANKTIVA) with durable NMIBC response data and multi-jurisdiction approvals, but a single product carrying 100% of revenue, negative equity, no positive owner's earnings in any filed year, BCG co-supply dependence, and financing that rests on the founder rather than the franchise; no ROIC history above the cost of capital exists to support a higher score.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
DILUTION: share count growing 32.0%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

SHARES_FALLBACK: no diluted share count filed for 2016, 2017, 2018 — those history years use the basic / outstanding / dei count recorded in the shares_tag column; per-share history there is approximate
one_liner: Cash-burning single-product biotech, moat 3/10 — ANKTIVA revenue is ramping (+92% YoY) but owner's earnings are negative on every base (TTM -$0.31/sh) with 32%/yr dilution, so it cannot clear 15% at $9.18; Tier F.
moat_for: Only approved IL-15 receptor agonist; ANKTIVA + BCG established in BCG-unresponsive NMIBC CIS with 84% 3-yr bladder preservation among responders
Approved or authorized in five jurisdictions spanning 34 countries, with label-expansion filings pending
Exclusive Tokyo-172 BCG supply agreement securing the co-administered input
moat_against: Single product = 100% of revenue; all pipeline indications are binary regulatory events
Competing bladder-preserving therapies evolving in the same niche; regimen depends on BCG supply and treatment-center capacity
Negative equity and persistent going-concern language mitigated only by founder-affiliated funding
Share count compounding 32%/yr with ~167M potential shares overhanging — per-share economics diluted as revenue grows
